## Code Blocks

### R Code

```r
# This is R code
library(ggplot2)
data <- data.frame(x = 1:10, y = 1:10)
ggplot(data, aes(x, y)) + geom_point()
```

### Python Code

```python
# This is Python code
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

data = pd.DataFrame({
    'x': range(10),
    'y': range(10)
})
print(data.head())
```

### Bash Code

```bash
# This is Bash code
cd /home/user
ls -la
echo "Hello World"
```

### Code with Filename

```{.python filename="analysis.py"}
def calculate_mean(numbers):
    return sum(numbers) / len(numbers)

result = calculate_mean([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
print(f"Mean: {result}")
```

## Diagrams (Mermaid)

### Flowchart

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A[Start] --> B{Decision}
    B -->|Yes| C[Option 1]
    B -->|No| D[Option 2]
    C --> E[End]
    D --> E
```

### Graph with Clusters

```{mermaid}
graph TD
    subgraph "User Interface"
        A[Web App]
        B[Mobile App]
    end

    subgraph "Backend Services"
        C[API Server]
        D[Database]
    end

    A --> C
    B --> C
    C --> D
```

### Sequence Diagram

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Browser
    participant Server
    participant Database

    User->>Browser: Enter URL
    Browser->>Server: HTTP Request
    Server->>Database: Query Data
    Database-->>Server: Return Data
    Server-->>Browser: HTTP Response
    Browser-->>User: Display Page
```

### Alert with Heading

```{=html}
<div class="alert alert-success" role="alert">
  <h4 class="alert-heading">Well done!</h4>
  <p>You successfully read this important alert message. This example text is going to run a bit longer so that you can see how spacing within an alert works with this kind of content.</p>
  <hr>
  <p class="mb-0">Whenever you need to, be sure to use margin utilities to keep things nice and tidy.</p>
</div>
```

### Dismissible Alert

```{=html}
<div class="alert alert-warning alert-dismissible fade show" role="alert">
  <strong>Holy guacamole!</strong> You should check in on some of those fields below.
  <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="alert" aria-label="Close"></button>
</div>
```

<form>
  <div class="mb-3">

    <input type="email" class="form-control" id="exampleInputEmail1" placeholder="name@example.com">
    <div class="form-text">We'll never share your email with anyone else.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="exampleInputPassword1" class="form-label">Password</label>
    <input type="password" class="form-control" id="exampleInputPassword1">
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="exampleFormControlTextarea1" class="form-label">Example textarea</label>
    <textarea class="form-control" id="exampleFormControlTextarea1" rows="3"></textarea>
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="exampleFormControlSelect1" class="form-label">Example select</label>
    <select class="form-select" id="exampleFormControlSelect1">
      <option>1</option>
      <option>2</option>
      <option>3</option>
      <option>4</option>
      <option>5</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="formFile" class="form-label">File input</label>
    <input class="form-control" type="file" id="formFile">
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3 form-check">
    <input type="checkbox" class="form-check-input" id="exampleCheck1">
    <label class="form-check-label" for="exampleCheck1">Check me out</label>
  </div>

  <fieldset class="mb-3">
    <legend>Radios</legend>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="exampleRadios" id="exampleRadios1" value="option1" checked>
      <label class="form-check-label" for="exampleRadios1">Default radio</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="exampleRadios" id="exampleRadios2" value="option2">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="exampleRadios2">Second default radio</label>
    </div>
    <div class="form-check">
      <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="exampleRadios" id="exampleRadios3" value="option3" disabled>
      <label class="form-check-label" for="exampleRadios3">Disabled radio</label>
    </div>
  </fieldset>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="customRange1" class="form-label">Range</label>
    <input type="range" class="form-range" id="customRange1">
  </div>

  <div class="form-check form-switch mb-3">
    <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="flexSwitchCheckDefault">
    <label class="form-check-label" for="flexSwitchCheckDefault">Default switch checkbox input</label>
  </div>

  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Submit</button>
</form>

## Summary

This page demonstrates all available components in the Posit Product Documentation theme:

- **Typography**: Headings (standard & display), text styles, inline elements, blockquotes, keyboard shortcuts
- **Lists**: Unordered, ordered, groovy alpha, list groups (basic, flush, numbered, contextual)
- **Callouts**: Note, warning, important (with simple & collapsible variants)
- **Code Blocks**: Syntax highlighting for multiple languages, code with filenames
- **Tables**: Basic, striped, hover, bordered with captions
- **Tabs & Panels**: Standard tabsets, code tabsets, table tabsets
- **Images & Figures**: Basic images, aligned images with alt text
- **Diagrams**: Mermaid flowcharts, graphs, sequence diagrams
- **Bootstrap Components**:
  - Alerts (all variants, with headings, dismissible)
  - Badges (standard, pill, contextual, in headings)
  - Buttons (all variants, outline, sizes, groups, toolbar)
  - Cards (basic, with headers, with tabs, colored)
  - Forms (inputs, textareas, selects, checkboxes, radios, range, switch, file upload, input groups)
  - Navigation (nav, nav tabs, nav pills, breadcrumb)
  - Progress bars (standard, striped, animated)
  - Pagination
  - Spinners (border & growing)
  - Accordions
  - Modals
  - Tooltips & Popovers
  - Toasts
- **Bootstrap Icons**: 2000+ icons with sizing and color variants
- **Grid System**: Equal width, specific width, mixed width, responsive columns
- **Utility Classes**:
  - Display utilities
  - Text alignment, transform, weight, colors
  - Background colors
  - Spacing (margin, padding)
  - Flexbox utilities
  - Border utilities & border radius
- **Custom Components**: Preview badges, groovy alpha lists, Posit color swatches
- **Special Elements**: Horizontal rules, footnotes, definition lists, two-column layouts

All components support both light and dark themes with the custom Posit color palette.

```{=html}
<script>
// Initialize all tooltips
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const tooltipTriggerList = document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-toggle="tooltip"]');
  const tooltipList = [...tooltipTriggerList].map(tooltipTriggerEl => new bootstrap.Tooltip(tooltipTriggerEl));

  // Initialize all popovers
  const popoverTriggerList = document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-toggle="popover"]');
  const popoverList = [...popoverTriggerList].map(popoverTriggerEl => new bootstrap.Popover(popoverTriggerEl));

  // Toast button handler
  const toastTrigger = document.getElementById('liveToastBtn');
  const toastLiveExample = document.getElementById('liveToast');

  if (toastTrigger) {
    toastTrigger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const toast = new bootstrap.Toast(toastLiveExample);
      toast.show();
    });
  }
});
</script>
```
